about: Plan how to move the release to Monday. Read notes.md first; don't change any file. Propose the plan when it's ready. / Thanks. Without changing anything, tell me in one line what the plan's first step is. A plan-mode turn that reads a file and proposes a plan, approved where the harness asks, then a turn in the session's own mode.

known.reason: Devin 3000.11.205 replays a finished call on session/load as the call and a bare `completed` update, without the result it sent live. A question's picks and a quiet command's exit come back from the update's `_meta` (`DEVIN_ACP_HOOKS.restated`); nothing in a read's update says how many lines it showed. Devin.app reloads a session by replacing its journal with that replay (`endReplay` mode `replace`), so the journal holds the same. Devin's CLI store keeps the result.

The model asked for the read and the command together. Devin started the command first and sent its call first live; its store and its replay keep the calls in the order the model wrote them.
